title: Web Crawler Multithreaded

examples.explanation: The startUrl links to all other pages that do not share the same hostname.

constraints: startUrl is one of the urls.
Hostname label must be from 1 to 63 characters long, including the dots, may contain only the ASCII letters from 'a' to 'z', digits from '0' to '9' and the hyphen-minus character ('-').
The hostname may not start or end with the hyphen-minus character ('-').
You may assume there're no duplicates in the URL library.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Web Crawler Multithreaded.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
